description: Updated after user-approved simplification: validate final same-image shell entrypoint on Docker-capable runner. Docker CLI unavailable locally. Run compose config with supplied DATABASE_URL owner URL, ZAQ_OWNER_PASSWORD, ZAQ_READER_PASSWORD and DBA credentials. Build image; fresh up provisions before migrations; down/up/recreated provision job validates without password rotation; failed bootstrap/invalid URL/receipt mismatch blocks app. Assert no credential files or volumes, no DBA/reader env in app, default server startup still migrates/execs. No separate installer Compose or Python suite. Existing administrative ExUnit tests cover shell and PostgreSQL/ParadeDB paths. Live Gist/image publication remains separate, image first, requires user request.
title: [zaq-f6s] Verify image lifecycle on Docker-capable runner before rollout
